record.question: Which one is not correct?
options: The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 applies to all citizens of India
The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 applies to all citizens of India outside India
The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 applies to all persons on ships and aircrafts registered in India
The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 does not apply to a citizen of India outside India
record.explanation: The NDPS Act applies to Indian citizens outside India, so the contrary statement is incorrect.
